jobs.title: Upper Division Clerk (BPS-13)
jobs.organization: Directorate General of Customs Valuation Karachi
jobs.description:
Upper Division Clerk (BS-13)
Qualification / Experience:
(i) Intermediate.
(ii) Successful completion of a 03 weeks Basic IT Training Course (including MS Office) conducted by the NITB shall be mandatory before expiry of the probation period; otherwise, the services of the appointee(s) shall be terminated without any notice.
Age Limit (including 5 years general relaxation): Minimum 18 years; Maximum 25+5=30 years.
